description.value: Bean to Cup is a specialty coffee house in Vernon that has been roasting its own beans since 1998 — notably, it claims to be the only specialty coffee bar in the North Okanagan doing so in-house. The cafe offers gourmet espresso drinks alongside a full breakfast and lunch menu of wraps, paninis, soups, and fresh-baked pastries, set in a space that includes a garden patio. It has earned three consecutive TripAdvisor Certificates of Excellence (2017–2019) and accepts Bitcoin Lightning payments.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and active (copyright © 2026, current hours posted), confirming Bean to Cup is open. Address (3903 27th Street, Vernon BC) and phone (250.503.2222) on the website match OSM tags. The website confirms online ordering and a food menu (wraps, paninis, pastries), supporting a Takeout value of true; no explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears in the website content, so those remain null despite the OSM internet_access=yes tag.
concerns: Website footer contains a suspicious external link to 'https://www.myanxietymeds.com/' embedded in the Bean to Cup footer — possible WordPress theme injection or site compromise; warrants a check.
TripAdvisor Excellence awards cited are from 2017–2019; no more recent recognition mentioned.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible cafe in Vernon with a confirmed website, matching contact details, and a full food and coffee menu — a useful stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tags include Bitcoin Lightning, on-chain, and CoinOS payment options, which is unusual for a cafe and may be of interest to some directory users.

wow_evidence: only specialty coffee bar in the North Okanagan doing so in-house
